---
title: "Past evaluations"
---

Tests given in previous years in the DAI course of L. Delafontaine and H. Louis
([CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)), published as is from
[their repository](https://github.com/heig-vd-dai-course/heig-vd-dai-course). The answers
are hidden under *Afficher la réponse*.

::: {.callout-warning}
Use them to practise only. They are no model of the tests of this course: their topics,
format and questions can be entirely different. The chapters are the reference. The
2023-2024 tests use Telnet where this course uses ncat.
:::
